Title: Unimodal Representation Learning
Expected_Outcome: Domain-specific deep representations learned for Genetic (1000 probes -> 128D), Behavioral (18 features -> 128D), and Environmental (31 features -> 128D) data.
Measured_Results: Genetic input: 1,000 probes -> 128-D; Behavioral input: 87 one-hot features (18 raw) -> 128-D; Environmental input: 31 features -> 128-D.
Supporting_Evidence: Checkpoint sizes: genetic_transformer_128d.pt (1,139,262 bytes), fitted ColumnTransformers and scalers.
Limitations_and_Assumptions: Unimodal models evaluated in isolation demonstrate high variance and moderate unimodal accuracy (Genetic: 67.86%, Environmental: 57.66%).
Remaining_Incomplete_Work: Prospective validation on external real-world sequencing platforms (e.g. RNA-seq vs microarrays) remains to be demonstrated.

Title: Cross-Modal Alignment & GAN Data Balancing
Expected_Outcome: Contrastive knowledge-level alignment of 128-D embeddings into a shared 32-D space; WGAN-GP data balancing of minority genetic controls.
Measured_Results: 46 synthetic control vectors generated by WGAN-GP to balance 69 real ASD cases (total 138 training samples). 0 synthetic samples in test set.
Limitations_and_Assumptions: GAN balancing does NOT improve MINN overall accuracy (94.56% -> 94.54%, -0.02%); it significantly improves sensitivity (+1.12%) and reduces false negatives (115 -> 87).
Remaining_Incomplete_Work: Cross-modal alignment is at the knowledge/class level, not matched patient level, due to lack of co-collected cohorts.

Title: Hierarchical Attention MINN Fusion & Benchmarking
Expected_Outcome: Dual-level attention network (Level 1 intra-modality, Level 2 inter-modality) outperforming unimodal and static fusion baselines on held-out test data.
Measured_Results: Test Accuracy: 94.54% (4727/5000), ROC-AUC: 0.9876, Sensitivity: 96.52% (2413/2500), Specificity: 92.56% (2314/2500), Brier Score: 0.0420.
Limitations_and_Assumptions: Evaluated on 5,000 in-silico class-conditional combinations reusing 24 held-out genetic samples ~208x. Naive 95% CIs [0.9392, 0.9518] underestimate uncertainty; genetic cluster bootstrap yields [0.9166, 0.9699].
Remaining_Incomplete_Work: Independent real-patient concurrent validation cohort (simultaneous blood and behavioral screening).
Validation_Status: PASS (Reproduced from Checkpoint; In-Silico Nature Disclosed)

Title: Explainability & Clinical Translation Framework
Expected_Outcome: Level-1 and Level-2 attention inspection, non-invasive latent counterfactual generator driving risk <= 0.35, FastAPI backend, and interactive dashboard.
Measured_Results: P001, P003, P005 counterfactuals reach P <= 0.35 (P001: 0.1207, P003: 0.0021, P005: 0.3302) with Delta_G = 0; 100% frontend/backend parity.
Limitations_and_Assumptions: Attention indicates neural representation emphasis, not biological causality. Counterfactual shifts occur in 32-D continuous latent space and do not directly translate to clinical therapies.
Remaining_Incomplete_Work: Bijective clinical feature mapping from 32-D continuous latent space back to specific questionnaire responses.
Validation_Status: PASS (Live Execution Verified with Transparent Disclaimers)
